Aten Ra.realmSkin: REALM-SUBSTANCE SKIN — LIVING SOLAR RADIANCE, NOT FLESH: The skin IS NOT human flesh, NOT biological skin, NOT a physical object. The body IS living solar radiance — divine light and heat given form, the same power as the Egyptian sun, but here condensed into a divine body. The skin surface is luminous and glowing, not because of paint or glow effects, but because the body IS light. Electrum-gold radiance forms the base — the deity's body is made of the same solar energy that Aten/Ra represents, the sun's divine fire shaped into a living being. The surface shifts between solid radiance and pure light depending on the deity's power state — sometimes the body looks almost solid like condensed sunlight, sometimes it blazes with raw solar fire. Lapis-blue solar circuit-lines run through the golden radiance like channels of cooled divine light — not inlaid into a surface, but part of the living light body. Turquoise faience-glow appears at joints and divine markings as cooler pockets of solar energy. Red desert jasper fault-lines are places where the solar radiance has been stressed — not cracks in ceramic, but flares of chaotic red-orange solar energy where raw power bleeds through the controlled golden form. The skin has NO human texture, NO pores, NO biological features — it is smooth, luminous, radiating warmth. When light hits the body, it doesn't reflect — it absorbs and amplifies, because the body IS light. The body IS the realm: Egyptian solar radiance, divine sun-fire given living form, the power of Aten made flesh (but not flesh — light).

Asgardian.realmSkin: REALM-SUBSTANCE SKIN — LIVING STORM-MATTER, NOT FLESH: The skin IS NOT human flesh, NOT biological skin, NOT a physical metal object. The body IS living storm-matter — condensed storm, thunder, wind, and the raw elements of the Norse tempest given divine form. The skin surface is dark grey-black, not because it is iron, but because it is CONDENSED STORM — the darkness of thunderclouds, the black of the void above Yggdrasil, the grey of the sky when Thor's hammer falls. The surface texture is not hammered metal but turbulent — it shifts and moves like storm clouds compressed into a body, with swirling darkness patterns that are NOT static but alive, like watching a thunderstorm from inside. Rune-wound scars are actual tears in the storm-matter — places where oaths have CUT through the condensed storm, and through those tears, blue-white lightning is visible INSIDE the body, the deity's internal storm-light bleeding through. Ash-root veins are places where Yggdrasil roots have grown through the storm-matter, pushing living wood through condensed thunder — the world-tree literally growing through the storm. Raven-feather shadow patches are areas where the storm-matter darkens further — permanent deep-shadow zones where Valkyrie death-energy has stained the storm itself. Blackwinter frost cracks are places where the storm-matter has been frozen — actual ice formations in the condensed storm, white-blue stress fractures from the cold beyond the void. The skin has NO human texture, NO pores, NO biological features — it is turbulent, shifting, alive with storm energy. The body IS the realm: Norse storm-matter, thunder and wind and void given living divine form, a walking tempest.

Olympian.realmSkin: REALM-SUBSTANCE SKIN — LIVING MARBLE, NOT FLESH: The skin IS NOT human flesh or biological skin. The body IS actual living marble — white-veined Parian marble, the same material Greek sculptors used for divine statues, but here ALIVE and WARM. This is the one faction where a physical material is canon — Greek gods were ALWAYS depicted as marble statues, and the deity IS that marble given life. The body IS a living marble sculpture — every surface is polished marble with natural veining. The marble has warm translucence, like real Parian marble glowing from within, but this glow is alive — it pulses with the deity's power. Bronze inlays are set INTO the marble surface like living laurel-veins — actual bronze metal flowing through marble veins, the way Greek artisans inlaid bronze into stone. The skin texture is smooth marble — NOT pores, NOT human skin, NOT biological. Gold-blue skyfire energy pulses through the bronze veins in the marble — light flowing through stone, power moving through a living statue. There are no human skin imperfections — the surface is the perfection of a master sculptor's marble, but breathing, moving, alive. The body IS the realm: Greek marble come to life, the divine made permanent and perfect through the same stone that has always carried the image of gods.

Kami.realmSkin: REALM-SUBSTANCE SKIN — LIVING SPIRIT-THRESHOLD, NOT FLESH: The skin IS NOT human flesh, NOT biological skin, NOT a physical object. The body IS a living spirit-threshold — the boundary between the material world and the spirit world given divine form. The deity exists at the exact point where physical and spiritual reality meet, and the body REFLECTS that — it is not fully solid, not fully immaterial, but the GATE between states. The skin surface shimmers between material and immaterial — parts of the body appear solid, parts appear as semi-transparent spirit-energy, the boundary shifting constantly. Torii-red sacred energy forms the base color — not paint, not lacquer, but the actual energy of the sacred threshold, the same energy that makes torii gates divine boundaries. Where the body is more material, it appears as deep torii-red spirit-solid. Where it is more spiritual, it becomes foxfire-blue-green transparency — you can see THROUGH the body at those points, the spirit world visible through the deity's form. Mirror-silver patches are points of total reflection — the deity's body acts as a divine mirror at these points, reflecting not just light but spiritual truth. The skin has NO human texture, NO pores, NO biological features — it shimmers, shifts, and exists between states. Parts of the body blur like ink in water at the edges — the threshold dissolving into mist. The body IS the realm: the sacred threshold itself, not material, not spirit, but the GATE between — a living boundary that is a god.

The body IS living Otherworld-mist — the substance of the Irish sídhe, the sacred fog that separates mortal Ireland from the divine realm, here condensed into a divine body. The skin surface is not solid in the human sense — it is condensed mist given form, moon-pale and shifting, with the silver-green luminescence of the Otherworld glowing through it. The body appears partially translucent — you can see the Otherworld THROUGH the deity, the green fire and silver light of the sídhe visible inside the mist-form. Silver vein-patterns run through the mist like living moonlight — not metallic inlays but channels of pure silver LIGHT, the light of the full moon over ancient Ireland flowing through the deity's body. Sidhe-green glow pulses within the mist — the green fire of the Otherworld, not sap but raw fae energy, the power that makes the sídhe mounds sacred. Root-lace patterns are not physical roots but living root-mist — tendrils of Otherworld-substance growing from the body, the same mist that takes root in mortal earth at sacred sites. Geas-scar marks are places where the mist has been torn and reformed with silver-green light — not cracks in wood but fractures in reality where sacred obligation has been written into the deity's very existence. The skin has NO human texture, NO pores, NO biological features — it is mist, moonlight, and fae-fire given form. The edges of the body trail into fog. The body IS the realm: Irish Otherworld-mist, the sacred fog of the sídhe, condensed into living divine form — a god made of the boundary between mortal and fae.

Empyrean.realmSkin: REALM-SUBSTANCE SKIN — LIVING DIVINE LIGHT, NOT FLESH: The skin IS NOT human flesh, NOT biological skin, NOT a physical glass object. The skin surface is luminous, radiant, and semi-transparent — not glass, but actual living light held in divine form. The body glows from within because it IS the light — there is no surface reflecting light, there is only light emanating outward. The base radiance is choir-white — the pure white of divine presence, not paint, not stone, but the light of the highest heaven. Seraph-gold light flows through the body like living hymn-energy — not veins of blood but channels of divine radiance, the light of the celestial choir flowing through the deity's form. Many-eye-blue awareness points flicker within the light body — not literal eyes but points of blue divine awareness, the omniscience of the hierarchy made visible as shifting blue lights within the golden-white radiance. The body is semi-transparent — you can see THROUGH it, but what you see through it is MORE light, not the background behind it, because the body IS light. Bell-metal seams at joints are not physical metal but resonance-lines — places where the divine light vibrates at a different frequency, the construction-marks of a being built by the hierarchy's order. The skin has NO human texture, NO pores, NO biological features — it is pure radiant light. The body IS the realm: divine light, the radiance of heaven, a god made of the same light that the hierarchy uses to see all things. Not glass, not crystal, not any physical substance — LIGHT.
